scripts.title: Interface Hub
scripts.code:
local INTERFACE_URL =
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PequenoGR/Gr_Script/refs/heads/main/InterfaceScript"

local oldHub = getgenv().GRHub
if oldHub then
    pcall(function()
        if oldHub.GUI then oldHub.GUI:Destroy() end
        if oldHub.MainFrame then oldHub.MainFrame:Destroy() end
    end)
end

getgenv().GRHub = nil

local httpOk, source = pcall(function()
    return game:HttpGet(INTERFACE_URL)
end)

if not httpOk or not source or source == "" then
    warn("[GR Hub] HttpGet failed: " .. tostring(source))
    return
end

local fn, compileErr = loadstring(source)

if not fn then
    warn("[GR Hub] Compile failed: " .. tostring(compileErr))
    return
end

local execOk, execErr = pcall(fn)

if not execOk then
    warn("[GR Hub] Exec failed: " .. tostring(execErr))
    return
end

print("[GR Hub] Script carregado com sucesso!")
